subject: Request: granular SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts & ownership confirmation
messages:
From: Julia Morris <julia.morris@auditworks.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: security@healthgrid.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence ask: SSO/SCIM/RBAC ownership and assertion samples

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick intake call today. As part of the SIG/SOC2 review for HealthGrid we need a targeted artifact set to validate access-control controls. Can you provide the following within 5 business days?

1) A SAML assertion sample that includes full NameID + attributes (with PII redacted) and the original assertion timestamp.
2) SCIM delta logs for the past 30 days (preferably newline-delimited JSON) showing create/update/deactivate events and the actor identifier.
3) RBAC owner map: CSV of roles, role owners, and scope (org/team/service).
4) A short narrative (1 page) describing how least-privilege is enforced when new roles are created and how approvals are recorded.

If any of the items are redacted/derived from different systems, flag that in the filename. We will need checksums for any attached bundles and a secure download link (no public buckets).

Cc'ing HealthGrid SecOps for visibility.

Appreciate it —
Julia Morris
Senior Auditor | AuditWorks
julia.morris@auditworks.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Morris <julia.morris@auditworks.com>
Cc: security@healthgrid.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence ask: SSO/SCIM/RBAC ownership and assertion samples

Hi Julia —

Thanks — we can deliver that. High-level plan and ETA below: 

- SAML assertion sample (redacted PII) + checksum: by EOD Wed 16 Jun (saml-assertion-sample.txt)
- SCIM delta logs (30d) exported as ndjson with actor id mapping and brief schema notes: by Thu 17 Jun. Will include a small delta extract up front for quick review.
- RBAC owner map (CSV) and a short narrative on role creation approvals: by Thu 17 Jun.
- Annotated access log (PDF) showing one example workflow for privilege elevation where we trace approvals and JIT token issuance: by Fri 18 Jun if needed.

We will provide a secure share (Redwood internal S3 signed link via our access portal) and include SHA256 checksums. If AuditWorks requires an encrypted bundle, confirm preferred cipher or we will use AES-256 with a passphrase delivered via DocuSign secure memo.

Also looping in Sean Gallagher (Security Ops) and Grace O'Connor (Customer Success) to coordinate handoff and ensure the artifacts contain the minimal PII.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence ask: Evidence delivery plan and redaction approach

Vanessa / Grace —

I'll own the SCIM export. Plan:
- Export 2027-05-12 -> 2027-06-12 as ndjson, include fields: id, externalId, meta.lastModified, active, operations, actor_id.
- We'll include a mapping file actor_id -> system (okta|azure|internal) and a short readme describing why some events have 'system' actor.
- Redaction: user.email -> replaced with user_hash (SHA256) + keep domain if HealthGrid asks for full domain mapping.

Putting a short runbook together now; will add the export link and checksum into the drive folder.

-Sean
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Morris <julia.morris@auditworks.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: security@healthgrid.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence ask: scheduling a quick calibration call?

Julia / HealthGrid team —

Thanks for the list. I can join a 20-minute calibration call tomorrow (Wed) at 10am PT to walk through the artifacts so your team knows where items live and what is redacted. Quick ask: if AuditWorks prefers a specific filename convention for ingestion, let us know now so we can mirror it in the bundle.

Also, HealthGrid SecOps — can you confirm whether you want emails fully redacted or hashed+domain preserved in the SCIM export? That will change the runtime of extraction.

- Grace O'Connor
Sr Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Julia Morris <julia.morris@auditworks.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: security@healthgrid.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence ask: follow-ups and ingest format

Thanks, team —

Hash+domain preserved is ideal for the SCIM export. For the RBAC CSV: include role_id, role_name, scope, owner_email (hashed), created_at, last_reviewed_at. For the SAML assertion sample we just need one complete assertion (with timestamps) — PII can be redacted but indicate where redaction occurred ("Subject/NameID redacted").

On the calibration call please note: our ingestion expects newline-delimited JSON for SCIM, and CSV with headers for RBAC. We don't need the annotated access log unless we see anything unexpected in the other artifacts, but keep it ready.

Julia

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Morris <julia.morris@auditworks.com>, security@healthgrid.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverables: SAML sample + RBAC owner map (initial drop)

Julia —

Attached are the initial artifacts for ingestion: saml-assertion-sample.txt (PII redacted; Subject replaced with SUBJECT_REDACTED; assertion timestamp preserved) and rbac-owner-map-202706.csv (roles/owners/scope). The SCIM ndjson export is still processing (large tenant); Sean will upload the 30-day delta by EOD Thu and add the actor_map.jsonl.

Drive links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleDriveLink (read-access link set to AuditWorks + HealthGrid).

Checksums (SHA256):
- saml-assertion-sample.txt: 3a7f4b2c...
- rbac-owner-map-202706.csv: b9e1c5a7...

If you confirm receipt and the file formats look good, we'll finalize the SCIM bundle and deliver the full export with checksum and short narrative by Thu EOD.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

(attachments: saml-assertion-sample.txt [text/plain], rbac-owner-map-202706.csv [text/csv])
